purpose: Test positive gain over direct MVS + DropGaussian + VCD/VCP, not recovery relative to TPS
covariance: Exact p=3 OAS of centered local neighbors, trace-normalized to the original isotropic KNN covariance
transfer_selection: First scene in each existing dataset wrapper, same fixed method and parameters; report both regardless of outcome

longer_budget_confirmation_after_positiv.reason: All three metrics improved at the fixed 3000-step screen; check persistence at the original full budget without changing the method

full_budget_checks_added_after_lego_reve.reason: Lego's early improvement reversed at 10000 steps; complete the other three already-screened scenes at the same full budget, including the initially negative fern, without tuning

repetitions: One run per method/scene using the existing fixed seed, no seed search
evaluation: Report all PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS outcomes, matched input hashes and protocols, initialization cost and total training time
caveats: 3000-step screening is not a final-convergence or all-dataset result
Positive early outcomes require longer-budget and untouched-scene checks
No test-metric search over neighborhoods, shrinkage formulas, or per-dataset constants
OAS is covariance regularization, not calibrated MVS reliability
Equal covariance trace does not preserve projected footprint or volume
